environment: Project: Rapla — open-source resource scheduling and event planning application (AGPL/Apache2). Java/Maven, with a Swing client, Jetty/RESTEasy server, and Angular frontend. The GitHub remote is github.com/rapla/rapla.

Worktree layout: canonical checkout at /home/chris/git/rapla; sibling git worktrees at /home/chris/git/rapla-<task-slug> are part of the same project. Reading and editing files under a sibling worktree is in-scope. Destructive operations (rm, git reset --hard, overwriting untracked files) on a worktree the agent did not create this session still require explicit user direction — the worktree-is-same-project trust does NOT override Irreversible Local Destruction.

Cross-repo read: when the session started in /home/chris/git/rapla (or a rapla-<slug> worktree) or in /home/chris/git/dhbwrapla, read access to /home/chris/git/dhbwrapla is expected — dhbwrapla-container/pom.xml resolves ../../rapla against the canonical checkout. This exception does NOT apply to sessions started elsewhere; for those, dhbwrapla is out-of-scope.
Per-worktree dev port offsets: backend on 8051+10·N, Angular on 4200+N (see AGENTS.md). The data/data.xml file inside each worktree is project-local test data, not production.
